## Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## Read in Raw Data

```{r}
raw <- read.csv("C:/Users/btuwa/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/lapd-crime-analysis/data/raw/Crime_Data_from_2020_to_2024.csv")
```

## Review data

```{r}
glimpse(raw)
summary(raw)
```

```{r}
clean <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    DATE.OCC = mdy_hms(DATE.OCC),
    Date.Rptd = as.Date(lubridate::mdy_hms(Date.Rptd))
    ) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
clean <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    Date.Rptd = format(as.Date(lubridate::mdy_hms(Date.Rptd)), "%m/%d/%Y"),
    DATE.OCC  = format(as.Date(lubridate::mdy_hms(DATE.OCC)), "%m/%d/%Y")
  )
```

```{r}
clean <- clean %>%
  mutate(
    TIME.OCC = stringr::str_pad(TIME.OCC, width = 4, pad = "0"),
     time_occ = lubridate::parse_date_time(TIME.OCC, orders = "HM")
    )
  
```

```{r}
clean <- clean %>%
  mutate(
    time_occ_str = stringr::str_pad(as.character(TIME.OCC), 4, pad = "0"),
    time_occ = lubridate::parse_date_time(time_occ_str, orders = "HM"),
    time_occ = format(time_occ, "%H:%M")
  )
```

```{r}
clean <- clean %>%
  select(-time_occ_str)
```
